Petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed on behalf of the Petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 0435/2022 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Malviya Nagar.
2. It is submitted that quashing of FIR is sought on the grounds of it being a sheer abuse as the 78 years old mother has been dragged into this litigation.
3. It is further submitted that FIR has been registered after three years of giving Complaint in 2019.
Furthermore, the Chargesheet has been filed 03 years thereafter.

Submissions heard.

sentences.text: Considering that the Chargesheet already stands filed and the grounds stated herein are essentially touching the merits which can be addressed before the learned Trial Court, the Petition alongwith pending Application, is disposed of with liberty to the Petitioner to raise these contentions before the learned Trial Court.
6. Learned Counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner No. 2/Mother of the Petitioner is an old age woman and she may be exempted from appearing in the Court.

7. The Petitioner is at liberty to move an appropriate Application before the learned Trial Court,
which may be considered sympathetically.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J NOVEMBER 28, 2025 N
